frames.narration: A request reaches the gateway. It creates a trace id, abc123, and a first span for the whole request.
The gateway calls the order service and sends the trace id and its span id in the traceparent header.
The order service calls the payment service and again passes the header, with its own span id as the parent.
Each service finishes its span with a start time, a duration and a status. The payment span is the longest: 1.8 seconds.
Every service sends its finished spans to the collector. The collector decides what to keep: all slow or failed traces and a small sample of the rest.
The trace store joins the spans by trace id and parent id and draws a waterfall: A contains B, B contains C. The wide bar for C shows at a glance that the payment service caused the delay.

states.store: waterfall: payment is the slow hop
